signature: SUBROUTINE ZTRSNA( JOB, HOWMNY, SELECT, N, T, LDT, VL, LDVL, VR,

params.name: job
howmny
params.reference:
-   `= 'A'`: compute condition numbers for all eigenpairs;
-   `= 'S'`: compute condition numbers for selected eigenpairs specified by the array `SELECT`.

params.name: SELECT
params.reference: If `HOWMNY = 'S'`, `SELECT` specifies the eigenpairs for which condition numbers are required. To select condition numbers for the j-th eigenpair, `SELECT(j)` must be set to .TRUE.. If `HOWMNY = 'A'`, `SELECT` is not referenced.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix T. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: VL
params.reference: If `JOB = 'E'` or 'B', `VL` must contain left eigenvectors of T (or of any $Q \, T \, Q^H$ with Q unitary), corresponding to the eigenpairs specified by `HOWMNY` and `SELECT`. The eigenvectors must be stored in consecutive columns of `VL`, as returned by ZHSEIN or ZTREVC. If `JOB = 'V'`, `VL` is not referenced.

params.name: ldvl
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VL`. $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge 1$; and if `JOB = 'E'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge N$.

params.name: VR
params.reference: If `JOB = 'E'` or 'B', `VR` must contain right eigenvectors of T (or of any $Q \, T \, Q^H$ with Q unitary), corresponding to the eigenpairs specified by `HOWMNY` and `SELECT`. The eigenvectors must be stored in consecutive columns of `VR`, as returned by ZHSEIN or ZTREVC. If `JOB = 'V'`, `VR` is not referenced.

params.name: ldvr
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VR`. $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge 1$; and if `JOB = 'E'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge N$.

params.name: s
params.reference: If `JOB = 'E'` or 'B', the reciprocal condition numbers of the selected eigenvalues, stored in consecutive elements of the array. Thus `S(j)`, `SEP(j)`, and the j-th columns of `VL` and `VR` all correspond to the same eigenpair (but not in general the j-th eigenpair, unless all eigenpairs are selected). If `JOB = 'V'`, S is not referenced.

params.name: SEP
params.reference: If `JOB = 'V'` or 'B', the estimated reciprocal condition numbers of the selected eigenvectors, stored in consecutive elements of the array. If `JOB = 'E'`, `SEP` is not referenced.

params.name: mm
params.reference: The number of elements in the arrays S (if `JOB = 'E'` or 'B') and/or `SEP` (if `JOB = 'V'` or 'B'). $\mathrm{MM} \ge M$.

params.name: m
params.reference: The number of elements of the arrays S and/or `SEP` actually used to store the estimated condition numbers. If `HOWMNY = 'A'`, M is set to N.

params.name: ldwork
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LDWORK} \ge 1$; and if `JOB = 'V'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LDWORK} \ge N$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

untranslated: check -13: tests the output argument M (its value is computed, not passed in)
notes: workspace check for LDWORK not reducible to a minimum: LDWORK.LT.1 .OR. ( WANTSP .AND. LDWORK.LT.N )
